displayName: Foundry Agent -> Azure AD Identity Map
description: Maps each Foundry / Agent Service agent (gen_ai.agent.name) to the Azure AD identity it runs under (managed identity / service principal, or a delegated user). The cross-table correlation hunts (AgentAutonomousAzureWrite, AgentIdentityOAuthEscalation, AgentSensitiveRetrievalOffice, AgentExternalExfiltration) join Foundry telemetry to AzureActivity / AuditLogs / OfficeActivity through this map, because those tables record the AAD identity (Caller / InitiatedBy / UserId), not the agent name. Populate AppId, ObjectId and Upn with lowercase values; leave a column blank if it does not apply. Without at least one identity column the correlation hunts return nothing for that agent.
